g.text: Direct interrupt: forces unlock & evacuation broadcast
Sounds on 3 invalid scans or unauthorized exit attempts
Enforces Sec 2.6: Persons inside CANNOT exit outside hours!
ESP32 Dual-Core Engine — FreeRTOS Concurrency & Synchronization Architecture
Decouples slow SD SPI I/O from ISR
Guards active occupant table in RAM
SPI Pins: CS: GPIO 27, MOSI: 23, MISO: 19, SCK: 18

help, status, occupancy, rooms, lights, login

, logout,
schedule show, schedule set <H:M>, logs [n], adduser, emergency
Security: SHA-256 password hash + 5-min session timeout
• Telemetry Payload: occupied (1B), light_on (1B), lux (2B), energy_sec (4B)
• Periodic 2-second heartbeat dispatched via ESP-NOW to Master
• Responds to Master emergency evacuation broadcast (Forces lights ON)
